SQL 查询记录
sources.url_or_ref:
SELECT d.brand_name, d.generic_name, d.specifications, 
       SUM(i.quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock,
       SUM(s.total_amount) AS total_sales_2025
FROM drugs d
LEFT JOIN inventory i ON d.drug_id = i.drug_id
LEFT JOIN sales_records s ON d.drug_id = s.drug_id AND strftime('%Y', s.sale_date) = '2025'
WHERE d.generic_name = '盐酸二甲双胍片'
GROUP BY d.drug_id;

sources.title: SQL 查询记录
sources.url_or_ref:
SELECT 
    d.brand_name AS 药品名称,
    d.generic_name,
    d.specifications,
    i.total_stock,
    s.total_sales_2025
FROM drugs d
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT drug_id, SUM(quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock
    FROM inventory
    GROUP BY drug_id
) i ON d.drug_id = i.drug_id
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT drug_id, SUM(total_amount) AS total_sales_2025
    FROM sales_records
    WHERE strftime('%Y', sale_date) = '2025'
    GROUP BY drug_id
) s ON d.drug_id = s.drug_id
WHERE d.generic_name = '盐酸二甲双胍片';
